set system host-name [parameter1].explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: The host name of the equipment is used to identify the equipment in the network.

set firewall family inet6 filter [parame.command: set firewall family inet6 filter DS-Lite-ACL
set firewall family inet6 filter [parame.explanation: This command fragment configures an IPv6 firewall filter named `[parameter1]` within the `inet6` address family in Junos OS.

term [parameter2].explanation: This command fragment configures a term within an IPv6 firewall filter, where `[parameter1]` is the filter name and `[parameter2]` is the term name.

parameters.name: term
parameters.explanation: The term number of the filter condition.

from source-address [parameter3].explanation: The command filters traffic based on the specified source IP address (`[parameter3]`) in a Junos policy or rule.

parameters.name: source-address
parameters.explanation: Source IPv6 address and prefix length.

then [parameter3].explanation: Configure IPv6 firewall filter actions and accept matching traffic.

parameters.name: action
parameters.explanation: Process actions for matching traffic, for example.

unit [parameter2].explanation: Configure the unit number of the interface.

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: Interface unit numbers that distinguish between multiple logical configurations under the same interface.

family inet6 filter input [parameter3].explanation: The command configures an IPv6 firewall filter (`family inet6 filter`) to process incoming traffic (`input`) with the specified filter name (`[parameter3]`).

family inet6 mtu [parameter3].explanation: The command sets the Maximum Transmission Unit (MTU) size for IPv6 (inet6) family interfaces to the value specified by `[parameter3]`.

set routing-instances [parameter1].explanation: This command fragment configures a routing instance named `[parameter1]` in Junos, allowing for separate routing tables and protocols within that instance.

parameters.name: routing-instance
parameters.explanation: Name of route example, e.g. net.

instance-type [parameter2].explanation: Configure the type of route example that is a virtual router.

parameters.name: instance-type
parameters.explanation: Type of route example, e.g. virtual-router.

parameters.name: route-distinguisher
parameters.explanation: Routers, used to distinguish between different VPN routes.

vrf-import [parameter2].explanation: Configure the VRF import policy for route examples.

vrf-export [parameter2].explanation: Configure the VRF export policy for route examples.
